text.text:
This restaurant is located beside of the road. It is Japanese ramen restaurant.

Decoration is nice and beautiful. We came here around 2 PM in the raining day, but there was no queue at all.

We order food as a set menu and two, only a few minutes to wait for our food. Food is delicious and standard.

text.text:
Affordable ramen restaurant in Taipei. There are menus under NT$200 per portion. Their noodle are soft and delicious. Their soup are nice.

They provide free flow drinking water.

If you plan to visit here, it's recommended to prepare your cash since they only accept cash only payment.

text.text:
I’ve eyed this ramen restaurant for the last month and I’ve finally got a chance to try it with my kids. Everything from the service to the staff to the food was spectacular. The staff was extremely nice, helpful and kind to my kids. The food came fast and fresh!

I’ve tried the tonkatsu ramen, pork katsu and the kids meal: pork with rice. My family and I loved everything!

I also love the fact that they have high chairs for children. Many restaurants in Taiwan can not accommodate that. They also have children bowls and utensils.

We’ve dined here twice & both times, it’s exceeded my expectations! Please support this gem in this neighborhood! Wonderful staff and delicious Japanese cuisine!!

text.text: Best ramen noodles I’ve had in Taiwan! If you like spicy food, I definitely recommend the signature spicy ramen. Also, try the shrimp shell garlic tempura with a beer to get things started. My new go-to place for ramen in Taipei 😀
